questions.question: How far should the three-line condense reach?

options.label: PR text + posting.md (Recommended)
options.description: Condense everything this PR adds, and also the older parts of posting.md (verify paragraph, forbidden instruments, --paginate note, closing rule). That file has the most slack, so the PR's net raise could come close to zero.

options.label: Only what the PR adds
options.description: Condense only the lines this PR adds or changes in posting.md, rvw-pr SKILL.md, ship SKILL.md and CLAUDE-REFERENCE.md. Older text stays as it is. The raise shrinks but stays positive.

options.label: Net zero
options.description: Same as the first option, but keep cutting until the total is at or below master's 301224, so the PR needs no raise at all. That may cost older rationale in posting.md.

questions.question: The budget file carries three BK-481 raise entries, one per round. None of them is on master yet. What should they become?

options.label: One entry (Recommended)
options.description: Replace the three with a single BK-481 raise from 301224 to the new total, with a one-line reason. The intermediate totals never landed on master.

options.label: Keep history, add a cut
options.description: Keep the three entries and lock in the lower total with --update. The register keeps the per-round record.

In what order should the split and the four test runs happen?

options.label: Split first, then test (Recommended)
options.description: Move the gh route into posting-gh.md and push. Then run all four combinations against that head, so the tests cover the text that will merge. Runs from before the split would have to be repeated anyway.

options.label: Test first, then split
options.description: Run the four combinations on the current head, then split. You learn now whether the routes work, but the split changes the files a pass reads, so at least the local runs would need repeating.

options.label: Test only, no split
options.description: Keep both routes in posting.md and run the four combinations. Every posting pass keeps reading the gh route.

questions.question: Which runs do I do, and which do you do?

options.label: Local here, cloud by you (Recommended)
options.description: I run both local combinations from this session. You start two claude.ai/code sessions: one with /rvw-pr 1174 as its first prompt (no MCP yet), one after GitHub MCP has connected. I then check the comment counts and lines on the PR.

options.label: All four by you
options.description: You run every combination yourself, and I check the results on the PR afterwards.
